user.title: Add a camera
user.description: Plays white, pink or ocean noise through a camera's own speaker. Which kind of camera is it?

menu_options.onvif: A camera with two-way audio (most makes)

onvif.title: Add a camera
onvif.description: Works with cameras that support the standard (ONVIF) way of sending audio to their speaker - most with two-way audio do. Enter the RTSP stream address you would use for the camera's video, and its login.

data_description.stream_url: For example rtsp://192.168.1.20:554/stream1. A login written into the address is used too.

tapo.title: Add a Tapo camera
tapo.description: Tapo cameras need your TP-Link account password, which is checked with the camera on your network and never sent anywhere else. Third-Party Compatibility must be on in the Tapo app, under Me > Tapo Lab.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the camera. Check the address and that it's on this network.
error.invalid_url: That isn't an RTSP address. It should start rtsp://
error.invalid_auth: The camera refused the username or password.
error.no_backchannel: The camera didn't offer a speaker this can use. Not every camera with a speaker supports the standard way of sending it audio.
error.is_tapo: That's a Tapo camera. Go back and choose Tapo, which uses your TP-Link account password instead.
error.not_tapo: That address doesn't answer like a Tapo camera.
error.third_party: The camera refused the password. Check it, and that Third-Party Compatibility is on in the Tapo app (Me > Tapo Lab).
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. The log has the detail.

abort.already_configured: This camera is already set up.
